title: Link persistence failures occur after live send/receive/rekey mutations
description: Post-fix correctness review: persistence errors happen after live mutations: send save failure leaves queued frame/advanced tuple; receive save failure commits replay/pin/receipt but returns no RxFrame; rekey save failure applies in-memory generation but reports failure. Define transactional or fatal fail-closed semantics so reported failure leaves no deliverable/ambiguous state. Add write/fsync/replace/anchor fault injection.
